<!--
See CONTRIBUTING.md, "How to contribute", for the full reasoning behind
this checklist.
-->

**What this changes and why**
The format-control feedback, IGSR requirement, or LaTeX bug this
addresses. Link the issue if there is one.

**Before / after**
If this changes visible output (spacing, alignment, a new default), show
what the affected page looked like before and after. Skip this section
if the change is purely documentation or has no visible output.

**Checklist**
- [ ] `./compile.sh` runs clean
- [ ] I checked the actual page(s) this change affects, not just that the build didn't error
- [ ] `README.md`'s "Fixes applied" list is updated, if this adds or changes a fix
- [ ] Original attribution (`LICENSE`, `EMU_Thesis.sty` header) is intact
